notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
Small quality of life update

1) Added in a timer to how long the current playthrough has taken - in options -> game
2) Added an option to toggle everyone's names on/off in multiplayer - in options -> game
3) Changed main menu high score. Now you can scroll through different pages to see everyone's score

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content: 1) Made the first jump on level 2 easier to succeed

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content: 1) Fixed a issue with people not being able to see their score if they are not in the top 10

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
1) Fixed the timing format on the leaderboard if it took them more than 24 hours
2) Removed a time limit. Now any time that is less than 5 minutes will be submitted to the leaderboard.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello apes!

We have made several fixes and adjustments in the latest update. Mainly being:

- Multiplayer lobby fixes. It's generally easier to use now
- Fixed bug with friends only games not working
- Fall speed lowered by 30%
- Multiplayer server browser updates
- Achievements (level 4 & above) reset as was previously inaccurate
